newsitem.title: USA: InterDigital says has $250 mln contract.
newsitem.headline: InterDigital says has $250 mln contract.

text.p: InterDigital Communications Corp said Friday it has signed a contract worth $250 million with Myanmar Posts and Telecommunications for telecommunications equipment.
InterDigital said the deal includes the cost of systems it will produce and the costs of a manufacturing plant Myanmar will build.
InterDigital said the deal calls for establishing a joint venture in the Union of Myanmar between the two companies for the local manufacturing of the equipment.
